problem.title: Find the Largest Almost Missing Integer

approaches.title: Case-based counting and endpoint analysis
approaches.summary: Handles k == 1 by counting frequencies, k == nums.length by finding the overall maximum, and intermediate k by checking whether the endpoint values occur only once across valid subarrays. Revision 2 preserves this strategy while simplifying control flow and adding early exits.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implements the case-based solution using a frequency bucket for k == 1, a maximum scan when k covers the full array, and endpoint uniqueness checks otherwise.

revisions.commitComment: better code formatting and early escape with no max tracking for case 1
revisions.rawCommitSubject: java 3471: better code formatting and early escape with no max tracking for case 1
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Refactors the same case-based strategy with flatter conditionals, reverse bucket scanning for an early return, cached array length, and an early exit when both endpoint candidates are disqualified.
